statement: AWS and NVIDIA expanded their partnership, with AWS planning to deploy 2 million additional GPUs across AWS global infrastructure in 2027-2028 using NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra, Rubin, Rubin Ultra and RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition, plus 100,000 GPUs cited for secure AWS infrastructure serving US government federal and national-security workloads.
why: A named multi-generation deployment commitment from the largest cloud provider locks in merchant-GPU volume two years out and spans current and next-generation parts.

impact.mechanism: A committed 2-million-GPU deployment pulls through accelerators, HBM, NVLink and fabric, and the data center capacity and power to host them.

evidence.excerpt: AWS plans to deploy '2 million additional GPUs' across AWS global infrastructure in 2027-2028
GPU models named for the new deployment: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra, NVIDIA Rubin, NVIDIA Rubin Ultra, and NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition.

confidence.basis: Joint announcement published on NVIDIA's own newsroom, a primary source, with named products and deployment years; no dollar value disclosed.
